item.title: Stanford Releases Full CS329Z Agent Engineering Course Materials
item.description:
Stanford's new CS329Z Engineering AI Agents course has published its lectures daily on YouTube and open-sourced both assignment repositories under the MIT license. The first assignment asks students to build a Claude Code-style agent harness from scratch without any agent framework, covering tool-call format design, BM25 retrieval, context compaction and a sandboxed terminal, with reference solutions running the full online test suite for about $0.05.

原文标题：斯坦福 CS329Z 开源全部课程与作业

Why it matters：顶级高校把 agent 工程课完整开源，作业即一套可跑测试的 harness 实战，对自学者价值极高。

item.title: Greg Kurtzer's Ginux Pivots to Userspace Kernel for Agent Sandboxes
item.description:
The Ginux project has abandoned its standalone bootable-kernel approach in favor of a configurable userspace kernel that runs as an ordinary Linux process, placing an explicit versioned contract between managed workloads and the host kernel. The team says its earlier experiment, in which an AI coding agent built a kernel capable of running a Rocky Linux 10 userspace under human architectural direction, proved feasibility but exposed Linux ecosystem limits, prompting a pivot toward a production-grade agent sandbox.

原文标题：Ginux 转型用户态内核 打造智能体沙箱

Why it matters：知名开源开发者 Greg Kurtzer 主导的项目从 AI 生成内核转向用户态沙箱，为智能体隔离提供新思路。

item.title: Microsoft and Tsinghua Study Finds GPU Kernel Failures Mostly Stem from Build and Environment Issues
item.description:
A Microsoft and Tsinghua team analyzed 300 closed GitHub issues across seven mainstream GPU kernel libraries and found that 60.33% of failures trace to compilers, build systems, or runtime environments rather than kernel code itself. Software incompatibility among drivers, CUDA, frameworks, and packages was the single largest cause at 25.33%, suggesting LLM training and serving reliability work should prioritize environment consistency and build pipelines.

原文标题：微软清华研究称 GPU 内核故障多源于编译与环境

Why it matters：首次以实证数据量化 GPU 内核库故障根因分布，对 LLM 基础设施运维有直接指导价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · compute · signal 68/100

item.title: BotPsy Debuts On-Device Agentic Assistant Under One Billion Parameters
item.description:
A Hugging Face team released BotPsy, a sub-billion-parameter agentic language model built to run as an on-device personal assistant, replacing costly and volatile cloud LLM calls with local inference. The post details evaluation protocols across ToolSandbox, GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, IFEval and related benchmarks, arguing that tool-use and general capability can coexist at a very small parameter budget.

原文标题：BotPsy 发布 10 亿参数内端侧智能体助手

Why it matters：端侧小参数智能体是替代云端调用的关键路线，该文给出完整评测口径，值得关注本地化 Agent 部署的读者一读。

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen Code 1.0 Merging Qoder Harness Into Open Source
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen Code 1.0 Preview, merging the Harness capabilities refined in Qoder into a single open-source kernel that gives developers an embeddable Agent runtime. The architecture evolves from single-process multi-session to multi-node multi-session, using a unified event model to separate reasoning orchestration from tool execution while centralizing model access, sandbox resources and MCP configuration. The existing stable branch remains available as 1.0 opens on a separate branch.

原文标题：阿里 Qwen Code 1.0 发布 融合 Qoder Harness 开源内核

Why it matters：阿里将 Qoder 的 Harness 能力并入开源内核，是 Agent 运行时架构层面的实质演进，对构建 AI 编程工具的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Adds Over $10B in Microsoft and Google Compute Deals
item.description:
Anthropic disclosed in its amended S1 filing over $10 billion in new compute commitments with Microsoft and Google: the Microsoft deal rises to $47.2B-$49.2B and Google's minimum to about $121.3B, both running through 2033 and payable regardless of usage. Alongside this, its IPO roadshow plans to sell up to 825M shares at $70-$78, valuing the company at up to $1.4T and raising roughly $64.4B.

item.title: Study Finds LLM Moral Choices Lack Stable Value Rankings
item.description:
A study of five LLMs including GPT-5.2, Gemini and DeepSeek found that models lack a consistent value ranking when comparing pairs of moral violations: reversing option order changed the ranking in 26 of 30 test blocks. Critically, averaging responses produces a clean, human-like moral hierarchy that matches no individual test set, so moral alignment scores should only be trusted if rankings hold on individual prompts and both answer orders.

原文标题：研究发现大模型道德选择缺乏稳定价值排序

Why it matters：该研究揭示了大模型道德对齐评估中的系统性方法缺陷，对关注模型评测与安全的研究者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Loongson 2K3000 Powers Fully Domestic Robot Car With ROS2 Stack
item.description:
Loongson announced a full-stack port of ROS2 Jazzy onto its self-developed smart robot car, running entirely on the Loongson 2K3000 processor and covering mapping, localization, gamepad teleoperation, robotic arm control and depth vision for object grasping. The 2K3000 is built on a 12nm process with eight LA364E cores at up to 2.5GHz and single-core performance comparable to Cortex-A76. The demo validates domestic compute for real-time robotics control and offers a reference design for industrial automation and smart warehousing prototypes.

原文标题：龙芯 2K3000 统一调度智能机器车完成全栈 ROS2 移植

Why it matters：国产芯片在机器人全栈软件链路上的完整验证，对关注自主算力与具身智能底座的读者有参考价值。

Banks deploying such agents will face stricter scrutiny and risk controls.

item.title: Reddit Tests AI Review Summaries Drawing Community Backlash
item.description:
Reddit is testing a Reviews feature that uses AI to aggregate user comments and analyze product pros and cons, helping users judge whether a product fits their needs. The announcement drew backlash from moderators and users who fear it blurs genuine opinions with sponsored content and invites spam. Reddit says the embedded product links are shortcuts, not paid ad slots, and brands cannot pay for placement.

原文标题：Reddit 测试 AI 汇总商品评价功能引发社区担忧

Why it matters：主流社区平台将 AI 摘要引入商品评价场景，涉及内容真实性与商业化边界，值得关注。

item.title: NVIDIA Edge Vision AI Speeds Up Mixed Waste Sorting at Recycling Plants
item.description:
NVIDIA's blog details a vision-AI-plus-robotics sorting system that identifies used clothing, bottles and mixed recyclables on conveyor belts, diverting thousands of tons of material from landfills. Running on edge Jetson modules with models trained on NVIDIA GPUs, it reportedly sorts in an hour what previously took a week and is rolling out to European facilities.

Why it matters：展示了视觉 AI 与边缘算力在循环经济场景的具体落地路径与部署进展。

item.title: US Imposes New Nucleic Acid Synthesis Screening Rules for Federally Funded Labs
item.description:
The U.S. government released a National Policy for Nucleic Acid Synthesis Screening requiring federally funded researchers to buy synthetic nucleic acids and benchtop synthesis equipment only from U.S.-approved suppliers, which must verify customer identity and screen orders for sequences encoding toxins or pathogens. Rolling out in stages over 340 days, it replaces voluntary self-regulation and is seen as a partial but meaningful biosecurity step, though it applies only to federally funded scientists.

原文标题：美国发布核酸合成筛查新政 分阶段 340 天落地

Why it matters：AI 降低病原体设计门槛的背景下，美国首次将合成 DNA 采购纳入强制筛查监管，直接影响生物科研供应链与 AI 生物安全治理。

item.title: SpaceX Taps SINGULUS for 100GW Space AI Compute Supply Chain

SpaceX signed a major supply contract with German equipment maker SINGULUS to bring in complete heterojunction (HJT) solar cell production lines, building in-house power capacity for its Starmind space AI compute satellites. The first line is slated for delivery in H1 2027, with plans to scale to over 100GW of equipment capacity, roughly 4.4 times the Three Gorges Dam's installed capacity.

Why it matters：太空 AI 算力首次出现明确的百吉瓦级供电产能规划，标志算力基础设施向轨道延伸。

item.title: Microsoft Auto SR Debuts on Handhelds with 120 FPS Performance Mode

A new Performance Mode raises the frame-rate cap from roughly 60-75 FPS to 120 FPS and can now run alongside Auto HDR. The rollout is staged and requires updated Xbox Game Bar, Windows 11, and the Auto Super Resolution Package from the Microsoft Store.

item.title: Software Design Shifts Toward Human Review as Agents Take Over Operations
item.description:
Bao Yu argues that once agents operate software on people's behalf, humans shift from executors to reviewers, so design should center on efficient result verification. Using Claude Artifacts, he illustrates three shifts: collaboration moves from human-to-human to human-to-agent, interaction moves from direct manipulation to markup and comments, and workflows move from user-led to agent-interviewed execution.

原文标题：Agent 接管操作后 软件设计重心转向结果验收

Why it matters：从交互设计视角提出 Agent 时代软件验收范式转变，对做 Agent 产品与工具设计的人有直接启发。

item.title: AMD Unveils Instinct Coder 355 with Eight MI355X Accelerators
item.description:
AMD and Spectro Cloud launched Instinct Coder 355, an enterprise AI coding platform built on eight Instinct MI355X accelerators plus dual 64-core EPYC 9575F CPUs, running GLM-5.3 locally at 98% of frontier-model performance. Each node serves up to 85 developers (50 concurrent) and defaults to on-prem compute instead of cloud APIs, targeting private enterprise coding workloads.

Why it matters：这是 AMD 以整机方案切入企业私有化 AI 编程市场的标志性动作，硬件规格与本地推理性能数据具体可查。

item.title: ACE Music v1 Debuts Atop Music Arena, Surpassing Suno v6
item.description:
ACE Studio released ACE Music v1, which debuts at #1 on Artificial Analysis' AA-Music-Vocal v1.1 leaderboard, ahead of Suno v6. The model generates full tracks with vocals or instrumentals from text prompts or user lyrics, performing best on Reggae/Dancehall and Classical/Orchestral styles. It has no API and is available only in the ACE Music app, with a free tier of 20 daily credits and paid plans from $7.90 per month.

item.title: Moore Threads Adapts MTT S5000 for MiniMax H3-Image on Day Zero
item.description:
Moore Threads announced that its MTT S5000 AI card and MUSA software stack were adapted for MiniMax H3-Image on the same day the model was open-sourced, enabling single-card generation of 4096×4096 high-resolution images. The adaptation reuses SGLang, MATE and MCCL components and targets the heavy attention overhead of diffusion models under multi-reference inputs, laying groundwork for Day-0 support of future image and video generation models.

原文标题：摩尔线程 MTT S5000 完成 MiniMax H3-Image 首日适配

Why it matters：国产 GPU 对开源生图模型实现首日适配，是观察国产算力生态成熟度的具体信号。

Its highlights include a physical spatiotemporal memory engine and a latent-space action-conditioned world model, though the 'world-leading' claim lacks third-party validation and quantitative benchmarks.

item.title: Anthropic Expands Claude MCP Apps to Embed Third-Party App Interfaces
item.description:
Anthropic expanded Claude's MCP Apps from in-conversation views to full embedded application interfaces, adding App Tools and Embedded Sites so users can operate apps like Adobe, Atlassian, Box, HubSpot and Notion directly inside Claude. It also granted Pro, Max, Ultra and Team users a one-time full usage reset after token over-consumption issues. Built on the open Model Context Protocol, the apps can run in other MCP-compatible AI clients.

Why it matters：MCP Apps 从对话视图升级为完整应用嵌入，是智能体与工具生态交互形态的实质演进。

item.title: 简单少样本提示即可让小模型追平复杂方法
item.description:
一篇论文发现，在自然语言推理（NLI）任务上，仅用一条简短直接的提示加少量示例（上下文学习），就能让 Gemma 2 9B、Mistral 7B、Llama 3.1 8B 等小型开源模型达到甚至超过以往依赖复杂提示与采样技巧的方法。Mistral 7B 在 MNLI 上超过已发表的上下文采样方法所取得的 63.4% 准确率，且 1 个示例与 15 个示例效果基本相当。

Why it matters：结论反直觉且可直接复用：少样本直给提示即可替代复杂提示工程，对使用小模型做分类任务的开发者有实际参考价值。

item.title: 月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 高速版上架 Amazon Bedrock
item.description:
月之暗面发布 Kimi K3.1 系列，其中 K3.1 Pro 高速版已上线 Amazon Bedrock。该模型基于 3T 级开源权重架构与 100 万 token 上下文窗口，通过大幅增加后训练算力，重点强化长程智能体任务、减少事实性错误，并提升金融建模、办公文档及游戏引擎、3D 场景与 CAD 脚本等专业编码能力。高速版输出速度达 K3.1 Pro 的 2 至 3 倍，且复用 K3 的端点与 API，开发者仅需修改模型 ID 即可切换。

Why it matters：3T 级开源权重模型叠加百万上下文与 2-3 倍推理提速，并通过 Bedrock 一键切换，对关注开源大模型落地与智能体长程任务的读者具备直接参考价值。
